title: The Wedding Before the Dream

voiceProfile.narrator: Third-person alternating close focus between Divya and Madhav
voiceProfile.tense: Past tense with close present-tense sensory scenes

characters.name: Divya Shukla
characters.description: Wildlife researcher with an incomplete thesis on swamp deer migrations. Married for four years.
characters.internalConflict: Loved her husband but felt suffocated by the domestic script of an extended Lucknow legal family.

characters.name: Madhav Shukla
characters.description: Civil court litigator. Diligent, affectionate, burdened by his father's expectations.
characters.internalConflict: Trapped between familial filial duty and the realization that his wife's vitality is quietly dying in their courtyard.

motifs: The heavy Nikon field binoculars hidden beneath folded silk sarees in the wardrobe
The courtyard clock in Lucknow that chimes with a heavy brass gong every quarter hour
The mud-splattered Mahindra Thar hired for the weekend trip to Dudhwa
The cup of ginger tea shared on a wooden veranda at sunrise without relatives watching
A marriage redefined not as surrender, but as a mutual pact of rescue
